The '''Alvorine Authority''' was the ruling government for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alvorine]] and ran the planet's security forces. The Authority made sure that any ships arriving on Alvorine only landed on certain areas of the planet to keep the ships from damaging the [[Crystal Monoliths]].<ref name="THH" />
